notes: BW25113 mazF deletion with chromosomal TetR-Ptet-mazF; aTc induction (inducer, not a treatment) at log phase OD~0.5, samples 0-8 min. t=0 (prior to induction) = control. genotype_class native_overexpression (native mazF re-expressed from an inducible promoter in a mazF- background) is a judgement.
